independence: Pending. The article states a bottom-up build from preclinical data and human physiological parameters. Its reference list (Springer page, read 29 October 2026) does not cite Ogawa 2008 or the CAN-1004 publication; the only clinical study code visible is CAN-1001 (Supplemental Fig. 2). The Methods have not been read and the author has not yet answered which clinical data were used. If either study was used to evaluate the model, a consistent result partly repeats the authors' evaluation; the report must say so.
dose_input_assumption: Assumption (not in the communication; question to the author pending): IV bolus added to the systemic plasma compartment, Cp increases by dose (ug/kg) / Vsys (L/kg); all compartments start at zero.

closed_form_without_binding.correction: First run: 0.5 h trapezoid of sampled concentrations gave 178.17 vs 174.25 (2.3%, failed) because of quadrature error in the check itself; the solver integral is used instead. No model value or endpoint depended on that quadrature.

decision.primary_condition: Table 2 parameters, primary body size, primary NCA reading.
decision.rule: The model is recorded as consistent with a study only if all of that study's primary endpoints are consistent under the primary condition. It is recorded as resolving the 3.0f and 3.0h findings only if it is consistent with both studies. A classification that changes across the sensitivity analyses is reported as not robust.

not_this: Not validation or qualification of the model; no acceptance limits are introduced.
Not a comparison of individual concentrations; only published means and SDs are used.
Not a re-fit: no parameter is estimated or tuned.
Not a dosing or exposure prediction for any patient.
known_differences: Typical-value model compared with arithmetic means of skewed quantities.
Small groups (Ogawa 1.3 mg/m2: n = 7 day 1, n = 5 day 11; CAN-1004 IV: n = 10).
Body size and dose input are assumptions.
Vsys (0.418 L/kg) was scaled from monkeys and is not physiological plasma volume.
No proteasome or red-cell turnover in the model; binding sites do not regenerate over the 11 days except by dissociation.
